00060 void ScopeComponent::paint(Graphics& g)
00061 {
00062     g.setColour(Colour(colours[Background].get32bitColour()));
00063     g.fillRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
00064 
00065     calculateBuffers();
00066     
00067     lock();
00068     
00069     if(minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00070     {       
00071         if(isBipolar)
00072             paintBipolar(g);
00073         else
00074             paintUnipolar(g);
00075     }
00076     
00077     unlock();
00078 }

00080 void ScopeComponent::paintBipolar(Graphics& g)
00081 {
00082     const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00083     
00084     if(numChannels > 0)
00085     {
00086         const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00087         
00088         const int channelHeight = getHeight() / numChannels;
00089         const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00090         
00091         const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00092             
00093         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00094         {
00095             const int top = channelHeight * channel;
00096             const int middle = top + halfChannelHeight;
00097             const int bottom = top + channelHeight;
00098             
00099             if(channel > 0)
00100             {
00101                 g.setColour(Colour(colours[TopLine].get32bitColour()));
00102                 g.drawHorizontalLine(top, 0, getWidth());
00103             }
00104             
00105             float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00106             float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00107             
00108             g.setColour(Colour(colours[Trace].get32bitColour()));
00109             g.drawVerticalLine(0, middle - oldMaximum, middle - oldMinimum);
00110             
00111             oldMinimum += 1.f;
00112             oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00113                                     
00114             for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++)
00115             {               
00116                 float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00117                 float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00118                 
00119                 float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00120                 float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00121                 
00122                 if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00123                 {
00124                     if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00125                     {
00126                         lineTop = 0.f;
00127                         lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00128                     }
00129                     else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00130                     {
00131                         lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00132                         lineBottom = 0.f;
00133                     }
00134                 }
00135                 
00136                 lineTop = middle - lineTop;
00137                 lineBottom = middle - lineBottom;
00138                                 
00139                 g.drawVerticalLine(i, lineTop, lineBottom);             
00140                 
00141                 oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00142                 oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00143             }
00144             
00145             paintXScale(g, middle);
00146             paintYScale(g, middle, top);
00147             paintYScale(g, middle, bottom);
00148             paintChannelLabel(g, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00149         }       
00150     }
00151 }

00222 static inline const String timeToTimecodeString (const double seconds)
00223 {
00224     const double absSecs = fabs (seconds);
00225     const tchar* const sign = (seconds < 0) ? T("-") : T("");
00226     
00227     const int hours = (int) (absSecs / (60.0 * 60.0));
00228     const int mins  = ((int) (absSecs / 60.0)) % 60;
00229     const int secs  = ((int) absSecs) % 60;
00230     const int ms = roundDoubleToInt (absSecs * 1000) % 1000;
00231     
00232     if(hours == 0)
00233     {
00234         if(mins == 0)
00235         {
00236             return String::formatted (T("%s%01d.%03d"), sign, secs, ms);            
00237         }
00238         else
00239         {
00240             return String::formatted (T("%s%01d:%02d.%03d"), sign, mins, secs, ms);         
00241         }
00242     }
00243     else
00244     {
00245         return String::formatted (T("%s%01d:%02d:%02d.%03d"), sign, hours, mins, secs, ms);
00246     }
00247 }

00250 void ScopeComponent::paintXScale(Graphics& g, const int y)
00251 {
00252     g.setColour(Colour(colours[ZeroLine].get32bitColour()));
00253     g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, getWidth());
00254     
00255     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00256     {       
00257         const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00258         const double samplesPerPixel = (double)getWidth() / audioBufferSize;
00259         
00260         const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00261         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00262 
00263         unsigned int mark = 0;
00264         const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00265         const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00266         
00267         g.setFont(textSizeX);
00268         g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00269         
00270         for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00271         {           
00272             const int x = audioIndex * samplesPerPixel + 0.5;
00273             
00274             if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00275             {
00276                 g.drawVerticalLine(x, y - markXHeight * 1.5, y);
00277                 
00278                 
00279                 if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00280                    (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00281                 ) {
00282                     String label;
00283                     if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00284                     {
00285                         label = timeToTimecodeString((audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00286                     }
00287                     else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00288                     {
00289                         double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00290                         double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00291                         
00292                         if(binFreq >= 1000.0)
00293                             label = String(binFreq * 0.001, 2) + T("kHz");
00294                         else
00295                             label = String((int)(binFreq + 0.5)) + T("Hz");
00296                     }
00297                     else
00298                     {
00299                         label = String((int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00300                     }
00301                     
00302                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextX].get32bitColour()));
00303                     g.drawSingleLineText(label, x + labelOffsetX, y - labelOffsetY);
00304                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00305                 }
00306             }
00307             else
00308             {
00309                 g.drawVerticalLine(x, y-markXHeight, y);
00310             }
00311             
00312             mark++;
00313         }
00314         
00315     }
00316 }

00318 void ScopeComponent::paintYScale(Graphics& g, const int zero, const int maximum)
00319 {   
00320     if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYNone)
00321     {       
00322         const double markSpacing = markSpacingY;
00323         const int decimalPlaces = decimalPlacesY;
00324         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopY;
00325         
00326         unsigned int mark = 0;
00327         const int labelOffsetX = markYWidth * 1.5 + 2;
00328         const int labelOffsetY = textSizeY / 2 + 2;
00329         
00330         const int height = zero-maximum;
00331         const double pixelFactor = (double)height / yMaximum;
00332         
00333         const double sign = height > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00334         
00335         g.setFont(textSizeY);
00336         g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00337         
00338         for(double level = 0.0; level <= yMaximum; level += markSpacing)
00339         {
00340             const int y = zero - level * pixelFactor;
00341                         
00342             if((((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)) && 
00343                (mark > 0) && 
00344                ((level+markSpacing) <= yMaximum))
00345             ) {
00346                 g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, markYWidth * 1.5);
00347                 if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYMarks)
00348                 {
00349                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[TextY].get32bitColour()));
00350                     g.drawSingleLineText(String(sign * level, decimalPlaces), labelOffsetX, y + labelOffsetY);
00351                     g.setColour(Colour(colours[LabelMarks].get32bitColour()));
00352                 }
00353             }
00354             else
00355             {
00356                 g.drawHorizontalLine(y, 0, markYWidth);
00357             }
00358             
00359             mark++;
00360         }
00361     }
00362 }
